result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and buildings situated directly at the sidewalk edge. While the narrow roadway width likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the environment lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings to designate pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of Schell St in the foreground

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk at the corner lacks a sloped transition, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner at the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars close to the intersection corner limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA curb ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a residential street with a continuous sidewalk that is heavily interrupted by multiple driveway curb cuts. Pedestrian safety is further compromised by trash bags obstructing the walkway and a lack of physical separation from the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trash bags and debris are placed directly on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking path and creating a tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Curb Cuts
hazards.description: Multiple garages with curb cuts create frequent points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path, increasing the risk of conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center of the image across the sidewalk

interventions.title: Designated Trash Collection Areas
interventions.description: Implement off-sidewalk trash storage or designated collection zones to ensure the pedestrian clear zone remains unobstructed.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk at Driveways
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level and material across driveways to signal pedestrian priority and encourage slower vehicle speeds.

result.summary: This is a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and a marked crosswalk at the foreground intersection. While the environment is generally walkable, the narrow sidewalk width and on-street parking near the intersection may limit visibility and pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles extend right up to the crosswalk, obstructing sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks are relatively narrow, which may force pedestrians to walk close to the roadway or parked cars.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with a continuous paved sidewalk and buildings set directly at the property line. While the narrow roadway likely encourages low vehicle speeds, the pedestrian environment lacks a buffer from traffic and contains several permanent obstructions like stoops and a fire hydrant.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A fire hydrant and residential stairs/stoops encroach into the sidewalk, reducing the clear walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and right-center foreground on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer zone between the sidewalk and the active travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the visible street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to create a vertical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety for people walking at night.
